name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus expands Slay the Spire 2 with clearer risk-reward choices: reworked Ancient relic rewards, A11-A20 test progression, Rootblight/Blight Sprouts, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, and preview tools for Crystal Sphere peek and transform preview. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 为《杀戮尖塔 2》加入更清楚的风险与奖励：先古之民遗物奖励重做、A11-A20 测试进阶、根芽/根蚀、火印精英、战旗房、首领专属能力，以及水晶球预知和变换预览等预览工具。需要 BaseLib。
